name: 4get
description: 4get: a proxy search engine that truly respects your privacy. - Rotating proxies on a per-scraper basis - Search filters (mostly missing in SearxNG) - Bot protection that actually works when enabled - Lightweight interface — no JavaScript required - Favicon fetcher with caching and image proxy - Plus a bunch of other useful features 👉 In short: the best way to actually browse without compromise. To customize the banner, replace it with your own image in: /mnt/user/appdata/4get/banner Recommended format: PNG, 400x100 px.

variables.name: FOURGET_BOT_PROTECTION
variables.description: Set FOURGET_BOT_PROTECTION=1 and mount a directory containing captcha files to /mnt/user/4get/captcha

variables.name: FOURGET_PROTO
variables.description: If https, put the valid certificates in the folder /mnt/user/appdata/4get/certs (fullchain.pem and privkey.pem)
